summary.text: Grant Green is a Republican state senator from Oklahoma Senate District 28 who took office in November 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Kevin Connor as his general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Green graduated from Wellston High School, owns Green's Propane and works as a farmer and rancher.
Green assumed office on November 23, 2022, succeeding Zack Taylor, and defeated Robert Trimble in the June 16, 2026 Republican primary.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Energy Committee and a member of the Administrative Rules, Agriculture and Wildlife, and Education committees.
